description: Once an identity is confirmed (one click on the dominant Continue button), there is no in-app way to link the computer as an existing identity: the Link this device path disappears, the Join form returns IDENTITY_MISMATCH for the person's own My device invitation, and identity cannot be replaced or removed. Recovery needs stopping the client and starting a new --data directory.
expected: While the client has no projects, offer 'Link this computer to my existing identity instead' (replacing the fresh unused identity), or let a My device invitation replace an identity that has no projects.
actual: "Destination already belongs to another identity"; CLI identity returns IDENTITY_EXISTS; only a new client directory works.
suggested_fix: Allow identity replacement when the registry has zero projects, and surface 'Link this device' on Welcome when no project exists.

description: The IDENTITY_MISMATCH headline "Destination already belongs to another identity" is internal jargon, and the hint explains the rule without saying what to do on this computer now.
expected: "This computer already has its own identity (Grace Liu, created just now), so it can't be linked as another identity. …" plus the actual recovery step.
actual: "Destination already belongs to another identity" + rule explanation.
suggested_fix: Rewrite the message and add a recovery action.

description: When the same person joins with a second identity, the project shows two identical 'GL Grace Liu' avatars and two identical 'Grace Liu · human' entries in Assigned to, with no way to tell them apart except the device list inside each profile.
expected: Disambiguation (email or device suffix), or a warning to the inviter/joiner that a person with the same name and email is already a member.
suggested_fix: Warn on join when name+email matches an existing member; disambiguate duplicate display names in lists.
